arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-10-02' AND date < '2019-11-01'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated in the 30-day window ending on the last day of the data, 31 October 2019. The count includes unlabelled transactions.
assumptions: The most recent day is 2019-10-31, the last day of the data, so the window is 2019-10-02 through 2019-10-31 inclusive (30 days).
All transactions are counted, including those without a fraud label, since the question asks about transactions made and not about fraud.
